hints.title: Reward Interval Structure
hints.text: Purchasing fruit i (1-indexed) covers fruits up to index 2 * i for free.

hints.title: Subproblem Formulation
hints.text: Let dp[i] be the minimum coins to acquire all fruits from i to n. Buying fruit i means the next fruit to buy is any index j in [i + 1, 2 * i + 1].

hints.title: Reverse Iteration
hints.text: Compute dp[i] from n down to 1. For each i, dp[i] = prices[i - 1] + min(dp[j] for j in [i + 1, min(n + 1, 2 * i + 2)]).

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Simple 1D backward dynamic programming with O(n) transitions.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Notice backward 1D recurrence with reward range 2 * i.
